translations.web: They will be for a sign and for a wonder to you and to your offspring forever.
translations.bsb: These curses will be a sign and a wonder upon you and your descendants forever.
translations.kjv: And they shall be upon thee for a sign and for a wonder, and upon thy seed for ever.
